_comment: Film 73 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 0.10 USD per track, 6 tracks, 2026-11-25). Method as Film 69: one track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H,1 | 2,3 | M,4 | 5 | 6 | E,A2 + end screen). Own mood for this film: night, quiet awe, the fragility of one life and a careful hope; no lyrics, no vocals. Files in /tmp/claude-0/f73/audio/music, not in the repo (URLs in music/urls.txt). Prompt sent = style + ' ' + 'A <len> track. ' + mood.
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, reflective editorial documentary about whether the people alive today could be the first generation that does not have to grow old and die. Night and quiet awe: a sleeping city under a wide starry sky, a single lit window, a slow heartbeat of time, the fragility of one human life and a careful, warm hope. Soft analog synth pads, a warm low string drone, sparse felt piano notes with long sustain, gentle celesta and music-box glints, faint airy textures like breath on a cold window, a little tape warmth. No drums, no percussion, no beat, no vocals, no lyrics, no choir with words, no melody hook, not pop, not epic, not triumphant, not sentimental, not a trailer. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, slow, made to sit under a speaking voice.

M0.chapter: H, 1 (every generation before yours had to die, the offer, would you; the fly; the second way, 2032; Kurzweil C1, critics, 2459, a bet on AI, the mice)
M0.mood: wonder at night: a slow breathing warm pad, single felt piano notes placed far apart like stars appearing one by one, a faint celesta glint now and then; an open question hanging in the dark sky; steady and calm throughout, no build-up

M1.chapter: 2, 3 (the copy: the fly brain switched on, the executive C3, a cubic millimeter, is that you?; the answer most people give, old forever)
M1.mood: curious and a little uncanny: a soft pulsing synth arpeggio very low in the mix like circuits thinking, glassy celesta tones, a cool airy pad; a tiny brain lighting up in a dark laboratory; calm and inward, a gentle unease, never tense

M2.chapter: M, 4 (subscribe call, the fair question, a world built around dying; say it works: till death do us part, the three-stage life C4, five careers, the inheritance)
M2.mood: warm and human: a tender felt piano figure of a few notes over a warm string drone, soft music-box glints; two old hands holding each other, a very long life ahead; intimate and quiet, a little bittersweet, no swell

M3.chapter: 5 (power and ideas change hands: Planck, star scientists, the Beijing parade microphone, who steps aside, who gets it)
M3.mood: grave and watchful: a low sustained string drone, slow dark pad chords, sparse deep piano notes, a distant soft metallic shimmer; old halls of power at night, a quiet conversation overheard; serious and still, restrained, no drama

M4.chapter: 6 (it doesn't have to go that way: healthy years, cheaper genomes, rules, term limits, Denmark, Montana, children)
M4.mood: gently hopeful: the warm pad opens a little, felt piano notes rise slowly in small steps, light celesta glints, a soft airy texture like first light before dawn; patient and constructive, calm, never uplifting pop

M5.chapter: E, A2 + end screen (the honest answer is a range, something has changed, would you, we are the first to be asked the question; closing call)
M5.mood: quiet awe and open hope: the night-sky pad of the opening returns with the far-apart piano stars, now slower and warmer, a wide still chord; unresolved but peaceful; ends on one long softly decaying open chord fading into silence
